answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on long-form story generation, which is representative of the major difficulties in long text generation.

answer_4.quote: Each pairwise comparison is labeled by three annotators. We use Surge AI for annotation due to observing higher-quality results compared to Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are shown two passages side-by-side; for each metric we ask them to annotate which passage is better, or possibly both or neither.
